text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, the first race in the Triple 
Tiara line. The stage is Hanshin 
Racecourse, where she also ran her debut 
race... however.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Triple Tiara is starting again 
this year! Who's gonna take the Oka Sho?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Last year's winner felt like a long-sought 
dream finally realized, which was great. 
Looks like we're in for plenty of drama 
this year too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ooh~...
choice_data_list: Now this is getting lively, huh.
Now this is getting lively, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right! It's completely different from the 
Make Debut. It feels like the whole 
atmosphere in the venue has transformed.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"A Classic race—the 'Oka Sho'. It really 
is that special of a race, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—I've come this far... I have to win, no 
matter what."

text_block_list.name: Shivering Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I have to live up to everyone's 
expectations...! I'll do my best, I'll do 
my very best...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Strange.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That girl just now looked really anxious, 
didn't she? Even so, her eyes were 
sparkling."
choice_data_list: It's a once-in-a-lifetime race, after all.
It's a once-in-a-lifetime race, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Every leg of the Triple Tiara can only be 
run during the Classic Class. There must 
be great joy in earning a spot in them.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: A once-in-a-lifetime...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...I see, I got it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm sure the girl who sparkles the 
brightest will win.

Fine Motion muttered that with an 
unusually earnest look. Now that she had 
renewed her resolve, there was a concern I 
needed to tell her. And that was—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Hey... isn't that girl, Fine Motion, 
rumored to be a descendant of royalty...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
No way, she can't be serious! ...Wait, 
she's serious? Is it bad if I take a 
photo?

Just as feared, her lineage drew intense 
attention and sparked a stir among the 
crowd.
Yet, she—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Good day to you all. I look forward to 
working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wah... So beautiful...

...In an instant, she captivated the 
audience, turning curious stares into pure 
admiration. I recall the exchange from 
earlier—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's eyes on me? Oh, that's not a 
problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because those very gazes are what make 
Fine Motion who she is.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I thank you all for your interest. Please 
enjoy yourselves to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: R-Royal...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Now then— Let's go with some sparkle♪
